name: PT Argo Pantes Tbk
summary: PT Argo Pantes Tbk provides integrated logistics solutions and textile products in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Textile industry and Rent. The company is involved in warehousing and storage, cold storage, bounded warehousing, cargo handling, transportation management, supporting transportation, and real estate owned/rented activities, as well as provides leasable ancillary facilities, including land, buildings, parking areas, and office spaces. It also offers yarns and fabrics. PT Argo Pantes Tbk was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
